design_description: A refined luxury-inspired design that combines an elegant black base with intricate gold ornamental artwork throughout the jersey. Subtle floral motifs, architectural illustrations, and decorative symbols are woven into the fabric as a tonal all-over pattern, creating depth without overwhelming the design. Gold logos, sponsor, collar, sleeve cuffs, and side accents reinforce the premium aesthetic and provide a rich visual contrast. The minimalist color palette allows the intricate detailing to shine, giving the shirt a sophisticated and timeless character. Overall, the design feels exclusive, elegant, and fashion-forward, blending football performance with high-end Italian-inspired styling.
